verifications.note: Hand-confirmed derived match (not a literal digit-for-digit substring): PD states TWICE, verbatim (search hits at 2 locations in the extracted text): 'Максимальный объем транспорта газа составит 105,12 млн. м3/сут' = 105.12 MILLION CUBIC METERS PER DAY, not per year. GEM's recorded Capacity=105.12 with implied CapacityUnits=bcm/y is a unit-slip: the digits were copied without converting млн м3/сут -> bcm/y. Correct conversion: 105.12 million m3/day x 365 = 38,368.8 million m3/year = 38.37 bcm/y (rounded).

fills.researcher_notes: UNITS: the source states 105.12 MMSCMD. It is recorded here as the source states it, with the matching units cell. The kilometer or bcm/y figure on the sheet is computed from it. UNIT-SLIP CORRECTION (flagged as a trap in the batch brief): source PDF gives 105.12 in million m3/DAY, not bcm/YEAR. Converted: 105.12 x 365 / 1000... actually million m3/day x 365 days = million m3/year; /1000 = bcm/year -> 105.12 x 365 = 38368.8 million m3/y = 38.37 bcm/y. Tier held at medium (not high) because an independent Interfax/Glavgosexpertiza story (lenta.profinansy.ru/news/3768212, 2025-03-24) separately reports the pipeline's capacity as 52 bcm/y -- a THIRD figure that does not reconcile with either 105.12 or 38.37 by any obvious unit conversion (52 bcm/y / 365 = 142.5 million m3/day, matching neither reading). The 105.12 million-m3/day figure is the most specific and directly-scoped to this exact object (1 string, Tambey field to KS Karskaya) from the detailed engineering PD; the 52 bcm/y figure may describe a different/larger scope (full build-out, multiple strings, or the whole Tambey-to-Bovanenkovo-Ukhta corridor's target throughput including future phases) -- filed as a spec concern in validity[] rather than silently discarded. Do NOT paste 105.12 as bcm/y -- that misreads a daily figure as an annual one (~2.74x too high); the sourced, unit-correct figure for THIS document's scope is 38.37 bcm/y.
